outcomes: Desktop opens on a black, viewport-sized scene with three real GLBs and no visible text or page chrome.
Hover reveals the matching information beneath the head and leaving dismisses the unpinned information.
Dragging rotates the actual sculpture without selecting a world or leaving its information open.
All three heads support keyboard focus, reveal, Escape dismissal and focus return; the atelier link remains correct.
All three heads fit the 390px mobile viewport; tapping each head reveals and dismisses its information without overflow.
When WebGL is unavailable, keyboard reveal controls still expose all three world identities and destinations.
limits: Software Chromium and emulated touch; not a physical mobile GPU or full accessibility certification.
